mapper.select: select a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio from bus_rel_org_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.from_type='org' and b.to_type='org' and b.to_pid_shareholders='1' where b.to_pid=#{pid} union select a.name_,a.identify_type,a.identify_number,b.shareholding_ratio from bus_rel_psn_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_pid_shareholders='1' and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' left join bus_rel_psn c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid}

select a.name_,a.identify_type,a.identify_number,b.shareholding_ratio from bus_rel_psn_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_pid_shareholders='1' and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' left join bus_rel_psn_bak c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid}

select a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio from bus_rel_org_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.to_pid and b.to_type='org' and b.from_type='org' and b.to_pid_shareholders='2' where b.from_pid=#{pid}

select a.name_,a.identify_type,a.identify_number,a.duty_code from bus_rel_psn_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.from_pid and b.to_pid_shareholders='0' and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' left join bus_rel_psn_bak c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.to_pid=#{pid}

select a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio,b.from_memo,b.to_memo from bus_rel_org a left join bus_rel b on a.pid=b.to_pid and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' and b.to_pid_shareholders='2' left join bus_rel_psn c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.from_pid=#{pid}

select a.name_,a.identify_type,a.sex,a.identify_number,b.relation from bus_rel_psn_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.to_pid and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='PSN' -- left join -- bus_rel_psn_bak c -- on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.from_pid=#{pid}

select a.org_name,a.identify_type,a.unisc_code,b.shareholding_ratio,b.from_memo,b.to_memo from bus_rel_org_bak a left join bus_rel_bak b on a.pid=b.to_pid and b.from_type='PSN' and b.to_type='ORG' and b.to_pid_shareholders='0' left join bus_rel_psn_bak c on c.pid=b.to_pid where b.from_pid=#{pid}
